title: Write-guard containment allowlist for harness memory and scratchpad roots
action: Per guard-hardening E1 (CONTEXT.md) and the plan Constraints. Implement the containment allowlist: after the existing canonical resolution of a write target (Edit/Write/MultiEdit AND extracted Bash targets), if the RESOLVED path is under <home>/.claude/projects/ or <system-temp>/claude/, the outside-root containment deny does not fire. Scope strictly: the exemption bypasses ONLY the containment deny - reservation/hold checks, gate-boundary checks, direct-edit denies and secret checks still run where applicable (in practice out-of-root paths do not hit repo-relative checks, but the code order must make that true by construction, not by accident). Fail-closed: if home or temp cannot be resolved, the allowlist contributes nothing and the deny stands. Resolve home and temp the way existing code in this crate does (search for existing home_dir/temp usage - onboard/source.rs has home_dir); on Windows honor the actual system temp (std::env::temp_dir). Find the containment failure emission (write_guard/main.rs around lines 177-228, the could-not-be-canonically-contained message) and thread the allowlist there for both the ordinary-checkout and granted-worktree shapes. Add unit tests beside the existing write_guard test style covering: (1) write to <home>/.claude/projects/x/memory/f.md allowed, (2) write to <temp>/claude/s/scratchpad/f.txt allowed, (3) write to a sibling worktree path still denied, (4) a traversal spelling (repo/../../.claude/projects/...) judged by resolved location - allowed only if resolved into an allowlist root, (5) unrelated out-of-root absolute path still denied, (6) unresolvable home/temp leaves deny intact (simulate via the code's seam, e.g. injectable roots - prefer parameterizing the check function with the roots so tests need no env mutation). Existing tests must pass unmodified; if one must change, STOP and report. Run the write-guard-focused tests plus the full suite (commands.test) and quote both summaries.

truths: resolved-path allowlist covers home .claude/projects and system-temp claude roots only
containment deny unchanged for every other out-of-root target
fail-closed on unresolvable home/temp, proven by a test

trace.outcome: Containment allowlist landed (E1): HarnessRoots (home/.claude/projects + temp/claude), resolution-first, fail-closed, injected roots for tests; exemption erases only the containment deny by code order. write_guard tests 80/0; full suite in worktree 994/1 with the sole red the known environmental worktree-cwd test (chip filed).
